terms.gloss: a decision, a resolve; what one has decided to do
evidence: Ter. Eun. 867: neque edepol quid nunc cōnsilī capiam sciō
terms.comment: Cōnsilium capere, make a decision (Caes., Cic.; Lewis & Short).

terms.gloss: a judgment, the view one has come to
evidence: Plaut. Pers. 373: ego dē hāc sententiā nōn dēmovēbor
Caes. BG 6.13: sī quī aut prīvātus aut populus eōrum dēcrētō nōn stetit

phrases.latin: nōn vīribus aut vēlōcitāte aut celeritāte corporum rēs magnae geruntur, sed cōnsiliō, auctōritāte, sententiā
phrases.english: great things are done not by strength or speed or quickness of body, but by planning, authority and judgment

phrases.latin: neque edepol quid nunc cōnsilī capiam sciō
phrases.english: and heavens, I don’t know what to decide now

sources: Lewis & Short: consilium · Lewis & Short: sententia · Lewis & Short: decerno
